youtube_description:
-- SUBSCRIBE -- 

This video explains what to do if you forgot your Apple ID password and don't have access to your trusted phone number anymore, or if you even forgot it. You can use a iphone, ipad, computer etc.

Videos mentioned in the video: 
Forgot Apple ID: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yZe_Fy4m-uc&t
Forgot Apple ID Password: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2vNPFRbwzcg
Forgot passcode: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Z-FP2WH2Ys

Link to iforgot.apple.com:
https://iforgot.apple.com/password/verify/appleid

The devices in the video:
1. iPhone 6 with iOS 11.4.1

Link to Apple's guide to find forgotten Apple ID: 
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201354

Link to Apple's guide to reset Apple ID password:
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201487

Contact Apple Support: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201232

Regards,
Simon
